backend: Intel CPU, one pinned logical processor, JAX 0.9.0.1, resident inputs, synchronized outputs, randomized within round
design: Three layer affine, dense, RMS and 3x3 convolution, four development sizes and two readouts each. Two new sizes per family and readout. Transfer uses two gated MLP shapes, two upstream basic-block chain shapes and two upstream strided bottleneck shapes. All variants and seeds of a graph stay in one split.
contracts: Two positive counts globally or by last axis, two squared-energy sums, count and maximum, three counts, same-site energy and maximum, mixed reduction axes, one full output and one sample. V0 returns only the main tensor. Separate always valid. Direct variadic candidate requires multiple aggregations with identical operand shapes and axes.
correctness: Compare main output to V0, auxiliary outputs to NumPy over diagnostic tensors. Exact signed i32 counts; shape, dtype and finiteness; float32 tolerance atol=rtol=0.0003, FP64 energy reference. A failed configuration is disclosed and excluded with its paired competitor. No repairs based on test latency.
measurement: Three independent development processes, 12 post-warmup rounds, seeds 29/4831. Five independent test processes, 20 rounds, seeds 733/4261/9521. Six warmup rounds. Test A/A four shuffled aliases per implementation. Report median process medians, paired ratio and increment to V0. Gain or loss requires majority direction and median paired absolute effect above the larger within-candidate 95th-percentile A/A floor.
strategies: Separate, joint wherever legal, source regression, source plus StableHLO regression, and a rule inspecting only the compiled separate program. The rule takes joint if an auxiliary-only full-domain exported compare, converted compare or square exists, otherwise separate. Charge separate compilation, reading/analysing the listing and conditional extra joint compilation when considering deployment.
prediction: Target absolute warm whole-forward T from dispatch until every output is ready; secondary C is measured wall time of jit/lower/compile, and cumulative C+H*T at H=1,1000. Constant, source, preoptimization StableHLO only, source plus StableHLO. Signed ridge on standardized log1p counters, log targets, regularization chosen by development leave-one-size-tier-out error. Freeze all test estimates before inspection and test timing. Inspect reference HLO and freeze rule decisions before any observation timing. No GPU runs.
decision: For each cohort separately, median symmetric multiplicative Q-error <=1.30 and p90 <=2.0 on valid observed configurations constitute the absolute accuracy target. Incremental IR evidence requires >=10% reduction in graph-balanced mean absolute log error of combined vs source, with a paired 95% bootstrap interval for the difference entirely below zero. Resample family/shape with its readouts, 10000 draws, seed 1871. Transfer contains only six graphs. Report total-latency prediction, decision quality, setup and observation increments separately.
scope: Fixed whole-tensor separate/joint menu, synthetic finite float32 inputs, initialized parameters and short Flax blocks, same host/compiler. Claims conditional on the observed candidate set and domains. No new fusion algorithm or upstream XLA pass claim.
